instruments.title: Add Noteikumi par automātisko informācijas apmaiņu par darījumiem ar kriptoaktīviem, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 751 of 9 December 2025 on the due diligence and reporting of reporting crypto-asset service providers to the State Revenue Service under DAC8

titles.lv: Noteikumi par automātisko informācijas apmaiņu par darījumiem ar kriptoaktīviem
titles.en: Regulations on the automatic exchange of information on crypto-asset transactions

payload.officialRef: Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 751 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 247, 23.12.2025.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a tax residence self-certification from each crypto-asset user and from an entity's controlling persons at onboarding
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 751 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 247, 23.12.2025.), 9., 12., 16. un 55. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Obtain a tax residence self-certification from each crypto-asset user and from an entity's controlling persons at onboarding

summaries.en: When it starts a relationship with an individual crypto-asset user, a reporting crypto-asset service provider obtains a self-certification that lets it determine the user's tax residence; for an entity user it obtains the entity's self-certification of whether it is a reportable user or has reportable controlling persons, and a self-certification of each controlling person's tax residence. For existing users it obtains the self-certification by 1 January 2027 for the first exchange.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a new self-certification when a change of circumstances shows the existing one is wrong
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 751 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 247, 23.12.2025.), 10. un 17. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Obtain a new self-certification when a change of circumstances shows the existing one is wrong

summaries.en: When a reporting crypto-asset service provider learns, through a change of circumstances, or has reason to know that a user's or controlling person's self-certification is incorrect or unreliable, it may no longer rely on it and obtains a new self-certification or a reasonable explanation, with documents where appropriate, supporting the original one.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stop a user from making reportable transactions after two unanswered reminders
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 751 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 247, 23.12.2025.), 42. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Stop a user from making reportable transactions after two unanswered reminders

summaries.en: If a crypto-asset user does not provide the due diligence information after two reminders following the provider's first request, sent no earlier than 60 days after it, the reporting crypto-asset service provider does not let the user carry out reportable transactions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each reportable user's crypto-asset transactions to the State Revenue Service by 30 June of the following year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 751 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 247, 23.12.2025.), 30. un 34. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Report each reportable user's crypto-asset transactions to the State Revenue Service by 30 June of the following year

summaries.en: A reporting crypto-asset service provider files with the State Revenue Service, through its electronic declaration system and in machine-readable form, the information on each reportable user and, for each type of reportable crypto-asset, the gross amounts paid or received, market values, units and numbers of exchanges, transfers and payment transactions, by 30 June of the year after the reporting period; the first report covers the period from 1 January 2026 and is due by 30 June 2027. The report counts as filed only once validated.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Correct the crypto-asset report within 20 working days of the State Revenue Service's notice
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 751 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 247, 23.12.2025.), 36. un 38. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Correct the crypto-asset report within 20 working days of the State Revenue Service's notice

summaries.en: Within 20 working days of the State Revenue Service telling it that corrections are needed, or passing on another reporting state's notice that the information is wrong or incomplete, a reporting crypto-asset service provider files the corrected or completed information electronically.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a record of the due diligence and reporting steps and information for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2025. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 751 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 247, 23.12.2025.), 43. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep a record of the due diligence and reporting steps and information for five years

summaries.en: A reporting crypto-asset service provider records the steps it took and all information it used to meet the due diligence and reporting requirements, and keeps the record available for five years, or longer up to 10 years after the end of the reporting period where an authority asks with reasons.

instruments.title: Add Kārtība, kādā sniedzama informācija par fiziskās personas kontu apgrozījumu un atlikumu, un skaidras naudas iemaksām, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 276 of 15 May 2018 on how credit institutions and payment service providers file the yearly report on residents' account turnover and cash deposits with the State Revenue Service
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 15. maija noteikumi Nr. 276 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 96, 17.05.2018.), consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2025; issued under section 22.³(2) of the Law on Taxes and Fees (preamble); entry into force: point 15 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2018. gada 18. maijā) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 18.05.2018.)

titles.lv: Kārtība, kādā Valsts ieņēmumu dienestam sniedzama informācija par fiziskās personas kontu apgrozījumu un atlikumu, un skaidras naudas iemaksām
titles.en: Procedure for providing the State Revenue Service with information on the turnover and balances of natural persons' accounts and on cash deposits

payload.shortName: Kārtība, kādā sniedzama informācija par fiziskās personas kontu apgrozījumu un atlikumu, un skaidras naudas iemaksām
payload.officialRef: Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 15. maija noteikumi Nr. 276 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 96, 17.05.2018.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Connect to the state data distribution network and file the account turnover report in the published XML structure
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 15. maija noteikumi Nr. 276 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 96, 17.05.2018.), 1., 2., 6., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2025

titles.en: Connect to the state data distribution network and file the account turnover report in the published XML structure

summaries.en: A credit institution or payment service provider files its report on resident natural persons' account turnover and cash deposits with the State Revenue Service electronically, in one or more messages built to the XML structure the Service publishes. It connects to the state data distribution network on its own, requesting user rights from the State Digital Development Agency, telling the Service the e-mail address for notices and asking to connect to the Service's channel.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the account turnover report within two working days after a network outage that prevented filing on time
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 15. maija noteikumi Nr. 276 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 96, 17.05.2018.), 10. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2025

titles.en: File the account turnover report within two working days after a network outage that prevented filing on time

summaries.en: If the data distribution network is down during the period the Law on Taxes and Fees sets for the report and the institution therefore cannot file on time, it files the report at once and no later than two working days after the network is restored.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Delete the account turnover data placed in or received from the network within five working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 15. maija noteikumi Nr. 276 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 96, 17.05.2018.), 11. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2025

titles.en: Delete the account turnover data placed in or received from the network within five working days

summaries.en: A credit institution or payment service provider deletes the data it placed in or received through the data distribution network within five working days of the day they were placed or received.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Resubmit the whole account turnover report when an error is found in it
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 15. maija noteikumi Nr. 276 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 96, 17.05.2018.), 12. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.01.2025

titles.en: Resubmit the whole account turnover report when an error is found in it

summaries.en: When a credit institution or payment service provider finds that information it filed under the regulation was wrong, it files the information again in full.

instruments.title: Add Noteikumi par informācijas apjomu, ko sniedz Valsts ieņēmumu dienests par politiski nozīmīgām personām, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 406 of 27 August 2019 on how obliged entities obtain, protect and keep the State Revenue Service's data on politically exposed persons
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2019. gada 27. augusta noteikumi Nr. 406 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 187, 13.09.2019.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 25(6) of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (preamble); entry into force: point 27 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2019. gada 1. novembrī) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 01.11.2019.)

titles.lv: Noteikumi par informācijas apjomu, ko sniedz Valsts ieņēmumu dienests par politiski nozīmīgām personām, un tās pieprasīšanas, izsniegšanas un glabāšanas kārtību
titles.en: Regulations on the scope of the information the State Revenue Service provides on politically exposed persons and on how it is requested, issued and stored

payload.shortName: Noteikumi par informācijas apjomu, ko sniedz Valsts ieņēmumu dienests par politiski nozīmīgām personām
payload.officialRef: Ministru kabineta 2019. gada 27. augusta noteikumi Nr. 406 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 187, 13.09.2019.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let only authorised staff, identifiable to the State Revenue Service, query its data on politically exposed persons
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2019. gada 27. augusta noteikumi Nr. 406 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 187, 13.09.2019.), 17. un 19. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Let only authorised staff, identifiable to the State Revenue Service, query its data on politically exposed persons

summaries.en: An obliged entity that requests and receives the State Revenue Service's information on politically exposed persons and their family members through the web service or the data distribution network ensures that only a responsible person it has authorised in its information system makes the requests, in a way that lets the Service's officials identify that person, and does nothing aimed at bypassing the database's security, overloading it without reason or damaging it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the State Revenue Service at once of unauthorised access, lost access data or security incidents affecting its PEP data service
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2019. gada 27. augusta noteikumi Nr. 406 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 187, 13.09.2019.), 18. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Tell the State Revenue Service at once of unauthorised access, lost access data or security incidents affecting its PEP data service

summaries.en: An obliged entity using the web service or the data distribution network informs the State Revenue Service by e-mail at once of any actual or possible unauthorised access to its system used for requesting information on politically exposed persons, of the loss or disclosure, or risk of it, of its access data, and of security incidents that threaten the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify changes to the access details given to the State Revenue Service at least three working days before they take effect
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2019. gada 27. augusta noteikumi Nr. 406 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 187, 13.09.2019.), 5. un 16. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Notify changes to the access details given to the State Revenue Service at least three working days before they take effect

summaries.en: An obliged entity that has applied for access with its registration number, legal address, responsible person, authentication method and IP address informs the State Revenue Service of any change in those details at once and no later than three working days before the change takes effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Store the politically exposed person data received electronically as the anti-money-laundering law requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2019. gada 27. augusta noteikumi Nr. 406 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 187, 13.09.2019.), 25. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Store the politically exposed person data received electronically as the anti-money-laundering law requires

summaries.en: An obliged entity stores the information on politically exposed persons and their family members it received electronically from the State Revenue Service in line with section 37 of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing.

instruments.title: Add Kārtība, kādā pieprasa un sniedz kredītiestādes rīcībā esošās neizpaužamās ziņas, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 393 of 22 June 2021 on how a credit institution answers investigators' and courts' requests for confidential client information through the state data network
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 22. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 393 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 122, 29.06.2021.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 63(3.¹) and (3.²) of the Credit Institutions Law (preamble); entry into force: point 39 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2021. gada 1. jūlijā) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 01.07.2021.)

titles.lv: Kārtība, kādā pieprasa un sniedz kredītiestādes rīcībā esošās neizpaužamās ziņas, arī ziņas darījuma pārraudzības gadījumā
titles.en: Procedure for requesting and providing non-disclosable information held by a credit institution, including information in the case of transaction monitoring

payload.shortName: Kārtība, kādā pieprasa un sniedz kredītiestādes rīcībā esošās neizpaužamās ziņas
payload.officialRef: Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 22. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 393 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 122, 29.06.2021.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Connect to the state data distribution network for confidential information requests and keep the contact details current
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 22. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 393 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 122, 29.06.2021.), 5., 6., 8. un 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Connect to the state data distribution network for confidential information requests and keep the contact details current

summaries.en: A credit institution starts the data exchange through the state data distribution network: after receiving user rights, and at least 10 working days before asking to connect to the centre's channel, it sends the centre its name, registration number, e-mail address, intended start date and contact person, tests the exchange and then asks to connect. It and the centre tell each other at least three working days in advance of changes to the e-mail address, contact person or start details, and exchange data in the agreed XML structure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pick up each request by the end of the next working day and answer within one, three or 10 working days by its kind
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 22. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 393 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 122, 29.06.2021.), 20. un 22. punkts un 21.1., 21.2., 21.3. un 21.4. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Pick up each request by the end of the next working day and answer within one, three or 10 working days by its kind

summaries.en: A credit institution retrieves each data request posted during a working day by 23.59 on the next working day, and posts its answer at once and within three working days for a person or account with statements of up to five years, within 10 working days for other objects, wider scope or older statements, within one working day for transaction monitoring statements, and by the end of the day, or the next day for applications after 16.00, for a monitored application to withdraw cash at a branch. If it finds the request faulty so that it cannot process it or identify the person or account, it posts a notice within one working day.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report network outages that delay requests and fall back on encrypted e-mail when the network cannot be used
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 22. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 393 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 122, 29.06.2021.), 20., 24., 26. un 29. punkts un 28.1., 28.2., 28.3. un 28.4. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Report network outages that delay requests and fall back on encrypted e-mail when the network cannot be used

summaries.en: A credit institution tells the agency and the requesting body at once of an unplanned network outage that affected retrieving a request and retrieves it as soon as technically possible. Where the network exchange has not started or an outage cannot be fixed within one working day, it exchanges data by e-mail secured with TLS, sending its contact address within five working days of the body's notice, signing its answers with a secure electronic signature and answering within the same terms, and within three working days of a monitored transaction for monitoring statements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Protect the exchanged personal data and keep audit logs of requests and answers for two years
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2021. gada 22. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 393 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 122, 29.06.2021.), 14., 15., 16., 17. un 23. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Protect the exchanged personal data and keep audit logs of requests and answers for two years

summaries.en: A credit institution uses technical and organisational means and user management that protect personal data and prevent unlawful processing, does nothing that threatens the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the information or the network's security, keeps its channel from overflowing, and keeps audit logs of the requests and answers placed in and retrieved from the network for two years, providing them within 10 working days of a requesting body's written request.

instruments.title: Add Kārtība, kādā veic datu apmaiņu attiecībā uz elektroniski nosūtāmiem rīkojumiem un paziņojumiem par to izpildi, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 167 of 21 March 2017 on how credit institutions and payment service providers receive and carry out the State Revenue Service's and bailiffs' electronic orders on clients' accounts
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 21. marta noteikumi Nr. 167 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 69, 04.04.2017.), consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2020; issued under section 18.²(9) of the Law on Taxes and Fees, section 66.²(8) of the Credit Institutions Law and section 44.³(10) of the Law on Payment Services and Electronic Money (preamble); entry into force: point 48 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2017. gada 1. jūlijā) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 01.07.2017.)

titles.lv: Kārtība, kādā veic datu apmaiņu attiecībā uz elektroniski nosūtāmiem rīkojumiem un paziņojumiem par to izpildi
titles.en: Procedure for exchanging data on orders sent electronically and on notices of their execution

payload.shortName: Kārtība, kādā veic datu apmaiņu attiecībā uz elektroniski nosūtāmiem rīkojumiem un paziņojumiem par to izpildi
payload.officialRef: Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 21. marta noteikumi Nr. 167 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 69, 04.04.2017.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Connect to the state data distribution network for tax and bailiff orders and keep the connection details current
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 21. marta noteikumi Nr. 167 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 69, 04.04.2017.), 6., 7., 9., 11. un 13. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2020

titles.en: Connect to the state data distribution network for tax and bailiff orders and keep the connection details current

summaries.en: A credit institution or payment service provider connects to the state data distribution network on its own, tests the exchange, sends the State Revenue Service and the Court Administration its connection details at least 10 working days before asking to connect to their channels, and tells them of changes to those details at least three working days in advance. It then exchanges orders and notices through the network in the published XML structure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out tax and bailiff orders in the order of their network number, and suspension orders without waiting
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 21. marta noteikumi Nr. 167 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 69, 04.04.2017.), 19. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2020

titles.en: Carry out tax and bailiff orders in the order of their network number, and suspension orders without waiting

summaries.en: A credit institution or payment service provider accepts for execution the orders of the State Revenue Service and sworn bailiffs in the sequence of the unique numbers the network gives them by the time they were posted. It carries out the Service's orders suspending a taxpayer's settlement operations regardless of that sequence, and takes a bailiff's order increasing a child or parent maintenance claim in the place of the order it replaces.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the issuer within one working day of an order it cannot process or match to a person
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 21. marta noteikumi Nr. 167 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 69, 04.04.2017.), 16. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2020

titles.en: Notify the issuer within one working day of an order it cannot process or match to a person

summaries.en: When a credit institution or payment service provider finds that the content of an order of the State Revenue Service or a sworn bailiff prevents it from processing the information or identifying the person, it posts a notice of the problem to the issuer of that order in the network channel within one working day.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose no tax or bailiff order to third parties and tell the client only after acting on it
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 21. marta noteikumi Nr. 167 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 69, 04.04.2017.), 21. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2020

titles.en: Disclose no tax or bailiff order to third parties and tell the client only after acting on it

summaries.en: A credit institution or payment service provider must not disclose orders of the State Revenue Service or sworn bailiffs to third parties. At the client's request it may explain the actions taken on the client's account and why, only after it has posted the notice in the network where the action follows an attachment order, or after it has carried out any other order.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Protect the order data and keep audit logs of orders and notices for three years
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2017. gada 21. marta noteikumi Nr. 167 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 69, 04.04.2017.), 20., 24., 26., 27. un 28. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2020

titles.en: Protect the order data and keep audit logs of orders and notices for three years

summaries.en: A credit institution or payment service provider does nothing that threatens the authorities' information or the network's security, uses technical and organisational means and user management that protect personal data, deletes the data it placed and received so that its channels do not overflow, and keeps audit logs of orders and notices placed in and retrieved from the network for three years, providing them within 10 working days of an authority's written request.

instruments.title: Add Kārtība, kādā sniedz informāciju par maksu, ko piemēro ar maksājumu kontiem saistītajiem pakalpojumiem, the Cabinet of Ministers' regulation No 480 of 7 August 2018 on the payment account fee data providers send the Consumer Rights Protection Centre for its price comparison tool
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 7. augusta noteikumi Nr. 480 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 157, 09.08.2018.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 46.¹(2) of the Law on Payment Services and Electronic Money (preamble); entry into force: the passport (Stājas spēkā: 10.08.2018.), the text having no such point; loses force 01.01.2028. (passport)

titles.lv: Kārtība, kādā sniedz informāciju par maksu, ko piemēro ar maksājumu kontiem saistītajiem pakalpojumiem
titles.en: Procedure for providing information on the fees charged for services linked to payment accounts

payload.shortName: Kārtība, kādā sniedz informāciju par maksu, ko piemēro ar maksājumu kontiem saistītajiem pakalpojumiem
payload.officialRef: Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 7. augusta noteikumi Nr. 480 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 157, 09.08.2018.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the payment account fee data the annex lists to the Consumer Rights Protection Centre by 1 March each year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 7. augusta noteikumi Nr. 480 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 157, 09.08.2018.), 2. un 4. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Send the payment account fee data the annex lists to the Consumer Rights Protection Centre by 1 March each year

summaries.en: A payment service provider that opens payment accounts sends the Consumer Rights Protection Centre, at its official e-mail address, the fees it charges consumers in Latvia for the account services the annex lists, for inclusion in the price comparison tool, no later than 1 March each year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the fees of a new payment account service to the Consumer Rights Protection Centre on the day it is launched
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 7. augusta noteikumi Nr. 480 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 157, 09.08.2018.), 5. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Report the fees of a new payment account service to the Consumer Rights Protection Centre on the day it is launched

summaries.en: When a payment service provider starts offering consumers a new service linked to a payment account, it sends the Consumer Rights Protection Centre the fee information for that service on the day the offering starts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the Consumer Rights Protection Centre of fee changes at least two months before they apply
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Ministru kabineta 2018. gada 7. augusta noteikumi Nr. 480 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 157, 09.08.2018.), 6. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Tell the Consumer Rights Protection Centre of fee changes at least two months before they apply

summaries.en: When information a payment service provider has sent changes, it tells the Consumer Rights Protection Centre of the change no later than two months before applying it, stating the date from which it takes effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a documented capital adequacy assessment at least once a year as at the year end and review its policies yearly
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 30. septembra noteikumi Nr. 321 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 03.10.2024.), 5., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Run a documented capital adequacy assessment at least once a year as at the year end and review its policies yearly

summaries.en: A credit institution assesses at least once a year whether the capital it holds is enough for its business, using the end of the reporting year as the reference date for all assessments and calculations. It documents the process with approved internal rules on its business model, risk and capital definitions, the identification of material risks and the methods used, and reviews and improves those rules at least once a year as its business and environment change.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Rerun the capital adequacy figures within a month of a material change and file the summary within 10 working days of approval
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 30. septembra noteikumi Nr. 321 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 03.10.2024.), 12. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Rerun the capital adequacy figures within a month of a material change and file the summary within 10 working days of approval

summaries.en: If material changes in the institution's business or environment between two assessments may materially change the results its supervisory board approved, the credit institution reviews the numerical results at once and within a month, making a new assessment if needed. Its supervisory board approves the revised results, and within 10 working days of that approval it files with Latvijas Banka a summary of the results in the form of annex 1.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have internal audit review the capital adequacy process and send its report to Latvijas Banka within a month of the board's review
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 30. septembra noteikumi Nr. 321 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 03.10.2024.), 13. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Have internal audit review the capital adequacy process and send its report to Latvijas Banka within a month of the board's review

summaries.en: A credit institution has its internal audit function regularly review the capital adequacy assessment process and its effectiveness and report to the supervisory board. Within a month after the supervisory board has considered the report, the institution files with Latvijas Banka a copy of it, an extract of the board minutes and the board's decisions on it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stress test three-year scenarios, including a reverse stress test, and hold the resulting additional capital buffers
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 30. septembra noteikumi Nr. 321 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 03.10.2024.), 47., 48., 52., 53., 54. un 56. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Stress test three-year scenarios, including a reverse stress test, and hold the resulting additional capital buffers

summaries.en: A credit institution analyses and documents its development over the next three years under a baseline and a severely adverse macroeconomic scenario, runs a reverse stress test to find the events that could breach its own funds requirements and the corrective measures, and from the severely adverse scenario sets an additional capital buffer, as a share of its total risk exposure amount, and a buffer for the risk of excessive leverage. It meets the additional capital buffer with Common Equity Tier 1 capital and the leverage buffer with Tier 1 capital.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Plan capital at least three years ahead and set capital adequacy and leverage targets
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 30. septembra noteikumi Nr. 321 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 03.10.2024.), 63., 64. un 66. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Plan capital at least three years ahead and set capital adequacy and leverage targets

summaries.en: As part of its business planning a credit institution plans its capital for at least the next three years, including a strategy for maintaining capital adequacy, and sets its desired capital level, its capital adequacy and leverage ratio targets, taking into account its strategy, risks, business environment, the quality of its governance and capital and its ability to raise more capital.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell Latvijas Banka at once when capital falls below the assessed need plus the additional buffers
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 30. septembra noteikumi Nr. 321 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 03.10.2024.), 67. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Tell Latvijas Banka at once when capital falls below the assessed need plus the additional buffers

summaries.en: If the capital a credit institution holds falls below the total of its assessed capital need and additional capital buffer, or of its capital need for the risk of excessive leverage and the leverage buffer, it informs Latvijas Banka at once of the situation, its causes and the measures it plans to restore its capital to a sufficient level.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the capital adequacy assessment report and result summaries by 31 May or 30 June of the following year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 30. septembra noteikumi Nr. 321 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 193, 03.10.2024.), 69., 70., 72. un 73. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File the capital adequacy assessment report and result summaries by 31 May or 30 June of the following year

summaries.en: A credit institution prepares a report on its capital adequacy assessment process with the content the regulation lists, together with the result summaries and documents it names, and files the summaries through Latvijas Banka's secure system and the report and documents at its official electronic address. It files them by 31 May of the following year if it is an other systemically important institution and by 30 June otherwise.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Count a debtor in default when past due amounts exceed 100 or 500 euros and 1 per cent for 90 days in a row
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 257 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 6., 7., 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Count a debtor in default when past due amounts exceed 100 or 500 euros and 1 per cent for 90 days in a row

summaries.en: An institution assesses the materiality of past due credit obligations against a threshold of 100 euros for retail and small and medium-sized enterprise exposures, or 500 euros for other exposures, and 1 per cent, using what it knows of all obligations the debtor owes it, its parent and their subsidiaries. A debtor is in default when both components are exceeded for 90 consecutive days, other than for a facility-level approach to retail exposures or a technical default, and the institution may use a lower threshold only where it can justify it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat every exposure to a defaulted debtor as defaulted across the institution and its prudential group
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 257 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 2., 5., 73. un 74. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Treat every exposure to a defaulted debtor as defaulted across the institution and its prudential group

summaries.en: An institution applies the regulation individually and at the level of its prudential consolidation group or sub-group, in every subsidiary of the group, and once it finds a default at debtor level it treats all exposures to that debtor in the institution and the group as defaulted. It tells Latvijas Banka when consumer protection, secrecy or other law restricts the sharing of client data within the group and so prevents consistent identification of default, and a Latvian parent that is not an EU parent keeps information flowing with its EU parent and the group's subsidiaries.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt internal rules for the credit risk capital calculation and a procedure for identifying default in good time
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 257 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 76., 78. un 80. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Adopt internal rules for the credit risk capital calculation and a procedure for identifying default in good time

summaries.en: An institution develops internal rules for calculating risk-weighted exposure amounts and the credit risk capital requirement, proportionate to its size, business and exposures, sets how deviations from them are reported to management, and adopts internal rules on applying the definition of default. These include a procedure for identifying default effectively and in good time that sets how default events, the days past due criterion and unlikeliness to pay are identified and how technical defaults are recognised.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document how the definition of default is applied, every default trigger and the criteria for return to non-default
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 257 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 84. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Document how the definition of default is applied, every default trigger and the criteria for return to non-default

summaries.en: An institution documents its application of the definition of default, including every indication used to identify default and the criteria for lifting default status, and states clearly the scope in which the definition is applied, recording in detail for each indication the process, sources of information and responsibility.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Classify exposures as items with particularly high risk under the EBA guidelines when using the standardised approach
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 257 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 75. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Classify exposures as items with particularly high risk under the EBA guidelines when using the standardised approach

summaries.en: An institution that uses the standardised approach determines whether an exposure is an item associated with particularly high risk in line with the EBA guidelines EBA/GL/2019/01 on the types of exposures associated with high risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Consolidate linked institutions, financial institutions and ancillary services undertakings by the full method under international accounting standards
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 266 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 2. un 3. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Consolidate linked institutions, financial institutions and ancillary services undertakings by the full method under international accounting standards

summaries.en: For Article 18(3) of the Capital Requirements Regulation a credit institution consolidates institutions, financial institutions and ancillary services undertakings by the full consolidation method of the international accounting standards where the companies are under common management by contract or by their founding documents or articles, or where at least half of the members of any management body are the same persons during the financial year. It uses the same full method for the undertakings referred to in Article 18(6) of that regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the Article 89(3)(a) treatment to qualifying holdings above the limits of the Capital Requirements Regulation
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 266 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 5. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Apply the Article 89(3)(a) treatment to qualifying holdings above the limits of the Capital Requirements Regulation

summaries.en: A credit institution applies the requirements of point (a) of Article 89(3) of the Capital Requirements Regulation to the amount of its qualifying holdings, and to their total amount, that fall within Article 89(1) and (2) of that regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use the liquidity coverage outflow rates as stable funding factors for off-balance-sheet exposures the regulation does not list
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 266 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 10. un 11. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Use the liquidity coverage outflow rates as stable funding factors for off-balance-sheet exposures the regulation does not list

summaries.en: Under Article 428p(10) of the Capital Requirements Regulation a credit institution applies to off-balance-sheet exposures not covered by Chapter 4 of Title IV of Part Six required stable funding factors equal to the outflow rates it applies to the related products and services under Article 23 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/61. An institution permitted to use the simplified net stable funding ratio follows the same approach.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat assets segregated under EMIR as encumbered for the term of the client liabilities they secure
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 266 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 12. un 13. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Treat assets segregated under EMIR as encumbered for the term of the client liabilities they secure

summaries.en: Where assets are segregated under Article 11(3) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012, as Article 428q(2) of the Capital Requirements Regulation mentions, and the credit institution cannot freely dispose of them, it treats them as encumbered for a period matching the term of its liabilities to the clients the segregation requirement covers. An institution permitted to use the simplified net stable funding ratio does the same.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the institution-specific countercyclical buffer rate as a weighted average, alone and at consolidated level
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 368 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 2., 3. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Calculate the institution-specific countercyclical buffer rate as a weighted average, alone and at consolidated level

summaries.en: A credit institution calculates its institution-specific countercyclical buffer rate individually and at the level of its prudential consolidation group, from the credit exposures in the classes of Article 112(g) to (q) of the Capital Requirements Regulation. It multiplies each applicable country rate by its own funds requirements for credit exposures to residents of that country, adds up the results and divides the total by its own funds requirements for all those exposures; a subsidiary abroad whose host rate differs uses the host rate individually and Latvijas Banka's rate at group level.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the countercyclical buffer rate of the country where each credit exposure is located
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 368 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 4. un 5. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Apply the countercyclical buffer rate of the country where each credit exposure is located

summaries.en: A credit institution determines the relevant credit exposures and their location under Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1152/2014 and applies Latvijas Banka's rate to exposures to Latvian residents. To exposures to residents of another member state or a third country it applies the rate that country's authority sets, capped at 2.5 per cent unless Latvijas Banka has recognised a higher rate, or the rate Latvijas Banka has recognised or set for that country, and a third country rate of zero where neither has set one.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply a raised buffer rate from the day announced and a lowered rate at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 368 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 6., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Apply a raised buffer rate from the day announced and a lowered rate at once

summaries.en: When a countercyclical buffer rate rises, a credit institution applies it in its calculation from the day and in the amount stated in the announcement of Latvijas Banka or of the other country's authority, as the regulation sets out for each case. When a rate falls it applies the lower rate at once, and it treats a change made in a third country as announced on the day that country's authority publishes it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell Latvijas Banka of plans to use an internal model for capital requirements at least six months before applying
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 350 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 3. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Tell Latvijas Banka of plans to use an internal model for capital requirements at least six months before applying

summaries.en: A credit institution informs Latvijas Banka in good time, and no later than six months before it applies for permission, of its plans to develop and start using the internal ratings based approach, the internal model method for counterparty credit risk, the alternative internal model approach for market risk or another internal model, approach or method under the Capital Requirements Regulation in calculating its capital requirements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report material changes and extensions of a permitted internal model to Latvijas Banka with the documents EU law requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 350 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 9., 10. un 11. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Report material changes and extensions of a permitted internal model to Latvijas Banka with the documents EU law requires

summaries.en: A credit institution permitted to use the internal model method for counterparty credit risk or another internal model informs Latvijas Banka at once of any material change in the information it filed with its application. One permitted to use the internal ratings based approach or the alternative internal model approach that extends or changes it files the documents that Delegated Regulation (EU) No 529/2014 or the other directly applicable EU acts require, in the way that matches the materiality of the change.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Self-assess compliance with the internal model requirements at least every three years and file the results
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 350 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 12. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Self-assess compliance with the internal model requirements at least every three years and file the results

summaries.en: A credit institution permitted to use the internal model method for counterparty credit risk or another internal model, approach or method assesses at least once every three years whether it still meets the requirements for using it in calculating own funds requirements, and files with Latvijas Banka the information annex 3 sets.

instruments.title: Add Procentu likmju riska netirdzniecības portfelī pārvaldīšanas noteikumi, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 254 of 27 November 2023 on how credit institutions and certain investment firms manage interest rate risk and credit spread risk in the banking book
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 254 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under sections 34.²(4), 50(2) and 101.³(5) of the Credit Institutions Law (preamble); entry into force: point 113 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2023. gada 31. decembrī) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 31.12.2023.)

titles.lv: Procentu likmju riska netirdzniecības portfelī un kredītriska starpības riska netirdzniecības portfelī pārvaldīšanas noteikumi
titles.en: Regulations on managing interest rate risk and credit spread risk in the non-trading book

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set an interest rate and credit spread risk strategy within the overall risk strategy and the capital and liquidity assessments
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 254 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 17., 18. un 19. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Set an interest rate and credit spread risk strategy within the overall risk strategy and the capital and liquidity assessments

summaries.en: An institution makes its strategy for interest rate risk and credit spread risk in the non-trading book part of its overall risk strategy, consistent with its capital and liquidity adequacy assessment processes. The interest rate risk strategy sets at least the aims and principles of managing the risk, the risk appetite and the desired level as the permitted impact of rate changes on economic value and on net interest income, also counting changes in the market value of instruments at fair value; the credit spread risk strategy sets the corresponding elements for that risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set, document and keep interest rate risk limits, escalate breaches and have exceptions approved by the management board
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 254 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 36., 37. un 38. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Set, document and keep interest rate risk limits, escalate breaches and have exceptions approved by the management board

summaries.en: An institution sets, documents and strictly keeps clearly defined interest rate risk limits that carry out its policy in line with its strategy and risk appetite and are applied when assessing a planned deal, at individual and consolidated level, sized to its business, capital and ability to manage the risk. It sets how management is informed in good time and who acts when a limit is or may be breached, and any exceptional departure from the limits that its policies allow is approved by the management board or a committee it authorises.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Measure every source of interest rate risk and stress test each currency, also with Latvijas Banka's test on request
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 254 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 57., 73. un 82. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Measure every source of interest rate risk and stress test each currency, also with Latvijas Banka's test on request

summaries.en: An institution measures interest rate risk across all its components and sources, stress tests it separately in each currency in which it has rate-sensitive instruments and in aggregate with a documented method of adding currencies up, applying currency-specific tests for its material currencies, and also runs the stress test, scenarios and assumptions Latvijas Banka sets when it asks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Validate the interest rate and credit spread risk models at least once a year and report the results to management
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 254 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 86., 87. un 92. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Validate the interest rate and credit spread risk models at least once a year and report the results to management

summaries.en: An institution validates the models it uses to assess interest rate risk and credit spread risk, and assesses their model risk, at least once a year under clearly written internal rules, by staff with the necessary competence. The validation ends in a report that records the results, conclusions and recommendations and goes to the level of management with the authority to decide on remedying the models' shortcomings and approve their use.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess and monitor credit spread risk in the non-trading book from all its sources and separately from other risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 27. novembra noteikumi Nr. 254 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 231, 29.11.2023.), 100., 104., 105. un 106. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Assess and monitor credit spread risk in the non-trading book from all its sources and separately from other risks

summaries.en: An institution assesses and monitors credit spread risk in the non-trading book across all its sources, including changes in market credit spreads and market liquidity spreads, so that it can see their effect on economic value and net interest income and their interaction over the short and long term. It runs a monitoring system for that risk and assesses it separately from interest rate risk and other risks, documenting and approving any diversification assumptions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the maximum distributable amount when the combined buffer requirement is not met
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 2. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 249 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 191, 03.10.2023.), 2., 3., 4., 5. un 6. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Calculate the maximum distributable amount when the combined buffer requirement is not met

summaries.en: A credit institution or investment firm that does not meet its combined buffer requirement calculates its maximum distributable amount by taking its interim and year-end profits not included in Common Equity Tier 1 capital, net of distributions and payments already made and of the taxes that would be payable if they were kept, and multiplying them by a factor of 0, 0.2, 0.4 or 0.6. The factor depends on the quartile of the combined buffer requirement in which its Common Equity Tier 1 capital not used for its own funds requirements falls, and the amount is reduced by any distribution or payment the Credit Institutions Law restricts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the leverage-related maximum distributable amount when the leverage ratio buffer is not met
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 2. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 249 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 191, 03.10.2023.), 2., 3., 8., 9. un 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Calculate the leverage-related maximum distributable amount when the leverage ratio buffer is not met

summaries.en: A Latvian credit institution that is a global systemically important institution and does not meet its leverage ratio buffer requirement calculates its maximum distributable amount from the same profit base, multiplied by a factor of 0, 0.2, 0.4 or 0.6 set by the quartile of the leverage ratio buffer in which its Tier 1 capital not used for its leverage-related own funds requirements falls, and reduces it by any distribution or payment the Credit Institutions Law restricts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify exposures to shadow banking entities and analyse their risks, interconnections and stress impact
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 27. maija noteikumi Nr. 300 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 103, 29.05.2024.), 4. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Identify exposures to shadow banking entities and analyse their risks, interconnections and stress impact

summaries.en: Within its risk management system a credit institution identifies its individual exposures to shadow banking entities and the risks they may bring, sets procedures to identify, monitor, control and mitigate those risks, and has its risk control function, overseen by the credit risk committee, analyse each entity's activity and the possible impact on the institution, including by stress testing. It sets procedures to identify interconnections among the entities and with itself, takes the risks into account in its capital adequacy assessment and planning, keeps its boards informed in good time and sets an action plan for a breach of its limits.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the supervisory board review the risk appetite, limits and process for shadow banking exposures at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 27. maija noteikumi Nr. 300 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 103, 29.05.2024.), 5. un 6. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Have the supervisory board review the risk appetite, limits and process for shadow banking exposures at least once a year

summaries.en: The supervisory board of a credit institution oversees the management of exposures to shadow banking entities and, at least once a year, reviews and approves the risk appetite and the aggregate and individual limits, keeping every setting and change of them documented, reviews and approves the management process, the risk analysis and the stress test results, and reviews the share of these exposures in all exposures against expected and actual losses. It may delegate those reviews to the management board.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set an aggregate limit and tighter individual limits on exposures to shadow banking entities
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 27. maija noteikumi Nr. 300 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 103, 29.05.2024.), 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Set an aggregate limit and tighter individual limits on exposures to shadow banking entities

summaries.en: A credit institution sets an aggregate limit on its exposures to shadow banking entities in relation to its Tier 1 capital, taking into account its business model, risk management, risk appetite, its current exposures and the interconnections identified. It also sets tighter individual limits, weighing each entity's regulation and supervision, financial position, assets and their quality, vulnerability to price or credit swings, the concentration of its banking activities and its interconnections.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Subject shadow banking exposures to the large exposure limit where the principal approach cannot be applied
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 27. maija noteikumi Nr. 300 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 103, 29.05.2024.), 9. un 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Subject shadow banking exposures to the large exposure limit where the principal approach cannot be applied

summaries.en: A credit institution that cannot apply the principal approach makes its aggregate exposures to shadow banking entities subject to the large exposure limit of Article 395 of the Capital Requirements Regulation. It applies this fallback to all such exposures if it does not meet the management requirements of the regulation, and only to the exposures on which it lacks enough information to set limits if it does meet them.

obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 264 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 4. un 6. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Document policies for assessing disclosure and for leaving out immaterial, proprietary or confidential information

summaries.en: A credit institution develops and documents policies for assessing its compliance with the disclosure requirements, including the procedures it applies when it relies on the exemption for immaterial, proprietary or confidential information under Title II of the EBA guidelines EBA/GL/2014/14. It assesses materiality against the considerations of Title III of those guidelines and the disclosure of proprietary and confidential information against those of Title IV.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose the information the EBA guidelines require when information is left out as immaterial, proprietary or confidential
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 264 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Disclose the information the EBA guidelines require when information is left out as immaterial, proprietary or confidential

summaries.en: A credit institution that uses the exemption from disclosure for immaterial, proprietary or confidential information discloses the information that Title VI of the EBA guidelines EBA/GL/2014/14 lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep prudential disclosures freely available for five or ten years after publication
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 264 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 5. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep prudential disclosures freely available for five or ten years after publication

summaries.en: A small and non-complex institution keeps the information it publishes under Part Eight of the Capital Requirements Regulation freely available for at least five years after publication, and a large institution or any other institution for at least ten years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Follow the disclosure requirements of a new prudential status from the period in which it is identified
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2023. gada 18. decembra noteikumi Nr. 264 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 248, 22.12.2023.), 8. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Follow the disclosure requirements of a new prudential status from the period in which it is identified

summaries.en: When a credit institution's status under the Capital Requirements Regulation changes, for example to a large or a non-listed institution, it meets the disclosure requirements of Part Eight for institutions of its new status, starting with the information for the period in which it identified that status.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt policies and a risk appetite for fiduciary operations and keep them apart from managing the institution's own property
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 348 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 2., 3. un 4. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Adopt policies and a risk appetite for fiduciary operations and keep them apart from managing the institution's own property

summaries.en: A credit institution that starts offering fiduciary operations develops, documents and approves policies and procedures that set out clearly the nature of the operations, how they are carried out and recorded and how clients are reported to. It sets a risk appetite for them within its overall risk management and keeps them separate from the management of its own property, so that the functions of the unit acting for clients and the tasks of its staff create no conflict of interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record client assets on a separate fiduciary balance sheet and hold them segregated and safe
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 348 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 5., 6., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Record client assets on a separate fiduciary balance sheet and hold them segregated and safe

summaries.en: A credit institution records placed fiduciary assets apart from its own balance sheet, on a separate fiduciary balance sheet broken down by client and asset type whose total equals the client funds placed, opens a separate off-balance-sheet account to hold them and keeps client assets segregated and safe at all times. Until client money is placed, and where no separate account can be opened, its nostro correspondent account balance in the currency must not fall below the money received and not yet placed, and a contract with another credit institution where client money is placed states that the money belongs to the client.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base each fiduciary relationship on a separate written contract that warns of the risks and contains no unfair terms
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 348 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 9., 10. un 11. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Base each fiduciary relationship on a separate written contract that warns of the risks and contains no unfair terms

summaries.en: A credit institution conducts fiduciary operations under a separate written contract that sets out the service, the rights, duties and liability of the parties, clearly warns the client of credit, market and custody risks, and states the amount entrusted, the possible investments, who receives the income, the notice for early withdrawal and how the client is told of the value of the assets. It acts in line with the contract's purpose, includes no unfair terms, and undertakes in the contract to manage the client's assets with the care of a prudent owner.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the client of each dealing in its assets with the institution or its shareholders and prove the price was fair
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 348 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 14. un 15. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Tell the client of each dealing in its assets with the institution or its shareholders and prove the price was fair

summaries.en: Where the contract allows the institution to buy its own or its shareholders' liquid assets for the client, to acquire or sell the client's assets to its shareholders, to act for both sides or to exchange the assets, it informs the client of each such action as the contract sets, unless the contract records that the client does not want the information. The price of such a deal is presumed to be the fair value or the price more favourable to the client, and the institution proves this at the client's request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Never encumber client assets, deposit client money for others or hand over custody without the contract's express consent
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 348 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 12. un 16. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Never encumber client assets, deposit client money for others or hand over custody without the contract's express consent

summaries.en: In fiduciary operations a credit institution must not encumber the managed assets to secure its own, its shareholders' or any third party's obligations, must not deposit the managed money in favour of third parties, and must not pass the management and custody of client assets to a third party unless the contract with the client expressly provides for it. Where the contract makes it take on further risks, it treats them as contingent liabilities in its capital adequacy calculation.

obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 21. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 326 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 207, 23.10.2024.), 2., 3., 4., 5. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Prepare the annual and consolidated annual report under international accounting standards, in euro, giving a true and fair view

summaries.en: An institution includes in its annual report the documents its sector law requires, and a credit institution, investment firm or management company preparing a consolidated report includes the consolidated financial statements, the parent's management report and a statement of management responsibility. The financial statements, with balance sheet and off-balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, statement of changes in equity and notes, give a true and clear view of the financial position, results and cash flows, are prepared under the international accounting standards adopted in the EU and use the euro, stating the precision of the figures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose in the management report the institution's details, its board members and the other facts the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 21. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 326 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 207, 23.10.2024.), 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Disclose in the management report the institution's details, its board members and the other facts the regulation lists

summaries.en: An institution discloses in its management report, or the group parent's, at least its name, legal address, registration and licence numbers, the names and positions of its management and supervisory board chairs and members, including those who left during the year, a review of its development, results and market position with its material risks and financial and non-financial indicators, its outlook, its own shares, its branches by country, its financial risk management where material and important events after the year end. A management company adds the funds it manages and the pension plans, state funded pension scheme assets and individual portfolios it manages.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Add a statement of management responsibility that records any board member's objection to the annual report
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 21. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 326 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 207, 23.10.2024.), 11. un 12. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Add a statement of management responsibility that records any board member's objection to the annual report

summaries.en: An institution states in its statement of management responsibility that the financial statements give a clear and true view of its or the group's position at the year end and its results and cash flows for the year, and sets out management's responsibility for proper bookkeeping and the other matters the regulation lists. Where a supervisory or management board member considers that the annual report cannot be approved, or raises objections to be reported to the shareholders' meeting, the statement says so specifically.
