obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an ATM within 20 kilometres of any place in Latvia and at least 45 ATMs per 100,000 active clients
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 330 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 6., 7. un 9. punkts un 5.1. un 5.2. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.11.2026

titles.en: Keep an ATM within 20 kilometres of any place in Latvia and at least 45 ATMs per 100,000 active clients

summaries.en: A listed service provider ensures that within 20 kilometres of any place in Latvia its clients have at least one ATM, its own or another provider's, where a natural person can withdraw cash on the regulation's terms, and that it provides at least 45 ATMs in Latvia for every 100,000 of its active clients at the previous 31 December. It may fall short of the distance rule where no more than 1 per cent of the population lacks such an ATM, and of the density rule where it has at least 30 ATMs per 100,000 active clients and all providers together exceed 45.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep each ATM open at least 12 hours a day and working at least 97 per cent of that time
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 330 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 5.3. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.11.2026

titles.en: Keep each ATM open at least 12 hours a day and working at least 97 per cent of that time

summaries.en: A listed service provider keeps each of its ATMs accessible and working every day for at least 12 hours between 6.00 and 24.00, or, for an ATM inside a public building or a public area of limited access, while that place is open to the public. Within that period each ATM is accessible and working for at least 97 per cent of the maximum possible time in the month.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let each card-holding natural person withdraw at least 750 euros a month free of charge
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 330 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 5.4. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.11.2026

titles.en: Let each card-holding natural person withdraw at least 750 euros a month free of charge

summaries.en: A listed service provider lets every natural person to whom it has issued a payment card withdraw at least 750 euros a month free of charge from its own ATMs in Latvia, however many withdrawals that takes. Where it relies on another provider's ATMs to meet the distance rule, it lets the client withdraw that amount free of charge from those ATMs in at least five separate withdrawals a month.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the ATM list to Latvijas Banka and give at least 10 days' notice of planned changes to the network
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 330 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 13., 14., 15. un 16. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.11.2026

titles.en: Report the ATM list to Latvijas Banka and give at least 10 days' notice of planned changes to the network

summaries.en: A listed service provider prepares a full list of the ATMs it provides in Latvia in the form the annex sets and files it with Latvijas Banka electronically through the secure system, the first time by 31 January for its position at the previous 31 December. It reports each planned new ATM or closure no later than 10 days before the change, a delay being allowed only for force majeure or for changes outside its control that it could not foresee.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give Latvijas Banka's inspectors the documents they ask for on the cash withdrawal service
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 28. oktobra noteikumi Nr. 330 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 212, 30.10.2024.), 20. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 12.11.2026

titles.en: Give Latvijas Banka's inspectors the documents they ask for on the cash withdrawal service

summaries.en: A listed service provider gives the persons Latvijas Banka authorises to inspect its cash withdrawal service, on site or remotely, the documents and information they ask for, including data on the actual opening and working time of its ATMs and on the fees it actually charged natural persons for cash withdrawals.

instruments.title: Add Finanšu pakalpojumu sniegšanas klātienē noteikumi, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 353 of 25 November 2024 on where and when the larger credit institutions in Latvia serve consumers in person
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 353 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 73.²(9) of the Credit Institutions Law (preamble); entry into force: point 23 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2026. gada 1. janvārī) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 01.01.2026.)

titles.lv: Finanšu pakalpojumu sniegšanas klātienē noteikumi
titles.en: Regulations on the provision of financial services in person

payload.shortName: Finanšu pakalpojumu sniegšanas klātienē noteikumi
payload.officialRef: Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 353 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Serve consumers in person permanently in Riga and in each city or county centre that meets the distance and client share tests
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 353 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 5., 6., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Serve consumers in person permanently in Riga and in each city or county centre that meets the distance and client share tests

summaries.en: A listed service provider serves consumers in person on a permanent basis, with the full range of in-person services and walk-in queues as well as appointments, in Riga and in each state city that is 40 kilometres or more by road from its nearest other permanent point and where its active clients are at least 20 per cent of the municipality's residents. It does the same in each county centre that meets the same distance test, has at least 25,000 residents not forecast to fall below that within two years, and where its active clients are at least 20 per cent of the residents.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Open each permanent service point at least 16 hours a week and serve booked consumers within five working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 353 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 9. punkts un 16.1. un 16.2. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Open each permanent service point at least 16 hours a week and serve booked consumers within five working days

summaries.en: A listed service provider keeps each permanent in-person service point open to consumers for at least 16 hours a week on at least two working days. Where it serves a consumer by appointment, at a permanent point or at an alternative place where it serves on request, it provides the service within five working days of the request, or sooner where unforeseen exceptional circumstances of the client require it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the list of in-person service points to Latvijas Banka and give at least 30 days' notice of planned changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 353 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 17., 18., 19. un 20. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Report the list of in-person service points to Latvijas Banka and give at least 30 days' notice of planned changes

summaries.en: A listed service provider prepares a list of its in-person service points in the form the annex sets and files it electronically through Latvijas Banka's secure system, by 31 January for its position at 1 January where it has not filed one before. It reports each planned change to the list no later than 30 days before it takes effect, a delay being allowed only for force majeure or for changes outside its control that it could not foresee.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the service points, their hours, services and how to use them on the website and at each point
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 25. novembra noteikumi Nr. 353 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 232, 28.11.2024.), 22. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Publish the service points, their hours, services and how to use them on the website and at each point

summaries.en: A listed service provider publishes on its website, and displays visibly at its in-person service points, information on the service points it provides, their type, opening hours, the in-person services available and how to obtain them.

instruments.title: Add Noteikumi par iesniedzamajiem dokumentiem atļaujas īstenot segto obligāciju programmu saņemšanai, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 317 of 17 September 2024 on what a covered bond issuer files to obtain a programme permit and to notify an issue, and how it keeps the documents current
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 317 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 36(4) and section 41(2) of the Covered Bonds Law (preamble); entry into force: the passport (Stājas spēkā: 20.09.2024.), the text having no such point

titles.lv: Noteikumi par iesniedzamajiem dokumentiem atļaujas īstenot segto obligāciju programmu saņemšanai un paziņojuma par nodomu emitēt segtās obligācijas iesniegšanai un šo dokumentu izskatīšanas kārtību
titles.en: Regulations on the documents to be filed for a permit to run a covered bond programme and with a notice of intention to issue covered bonds, and on how they are examined

payload.shortName: Noteikumi par iesniedzamajiem dokumentiem atļaujas īstenot segto obligāciju programmu saņemšanai
payload.officialRef: Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 317 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the documents and programme details the regulation lists when applying for a covered bond programme permit
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 317 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 2., 3. un 6. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File the documents and programme details the regulation lists when applying for a covered bond programme permit

summaries.en: An issuer applying for a permit to run a covered bond programme files an application listing its annexes, its governing body's decision, the programme with at least the general details, cover asset data, organisational structure, start-up cost forecast and criteria for material changes the regulation lists, its internal rules on the cover pool, the cover pool monitor, the competent person and stress testing, the covered bond company's internal documents, the draft monitoring, guarantee, transfer and management contracts, the continuity plan and the index of documents in the annex. It need not refile documents Latvijas Banka already holds unchanged if it says when they were filed and confirms they have not changed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Attach the governing body's decision and the cover asset data to each notice of an intended covered bond issue
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 317 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 4. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Attach the governing body's decision and the cover asset data to each notice of an intended covered bond issue

summaries.en: With a notice under section 36(3) of the Covered Bonds Law of its intention to issue covered bonds under an approved programme, an issuer files a copy or draft of its competent governing body's decision on the issue and the information on the assets in the cover pool that the regulation requires in the programme.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send Latvijas Banka amended documents at once during its review and report later changes within 14 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 317 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 5. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Send Latvijas Banka amended documents at once during its review and report later changes within 14 days

summaries.en: If documents or information filed for a permit or with a notice change while Latvijas Banka is examining them, the issuer files the amended documents or information at once. After it has the permit, it informs Latvijas Banka within 14 days of any change to the documents annexed to its application.

instruments.title: Add Pārskata par segtajiem noguldījumiem sagatavošanas un maksājumu noguldījumu garantiju fondā aprēķināšanas noteikumi, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 421 of 29 June 2026 on the quarterly covered deposits report and how contributions to the deposit guarantee fund are calculated and paid
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2026. gada 29. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 421 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 123, 01.07.2026.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 8(9) and section 11(2) of the Deposit Guarantee Law (preamble); entry into force: the passport (Stājas spēkā: 02.07.2026.), the text having no such point

titles.lv: Pārskata par segtajiem noguldījumiem sagatavošanas un maksājumu noguldījumu garantiju fondā aprēķināšanas noteikumi
titles.en: Regulations on preparing the covered deposits report and calculating contributions to the deposit guarantee fund

payload.shortName: Pārskata par segtajiem noguldījumiem sagatavošanas un maksājumu noguldījumu garantiju fondā aprēķināšanas noteikumi
payload.officialRef: Latvijas Bankas 2026. gada 29. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 421 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 123, 01.07.2026.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the covered deposits report each quarter by the 20th of the following month through Latvijas Banka's secure system
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2026. gada 29. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 421 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 123, 01.07.2026.), 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File the covered deposits report each quarter by the 20th of the following month through Latvijas Banka's secure system

summaries.en: A deposit taker prepares the covered deposits report in the form of annex 1 once each calendar quarter and files it with Latvijas Banka by the 20th day of the first month of the next quarter. A credit institution or the participating branch of an EU credit institution files it electronically through Latvijas Banka's secure system.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each depositor's covered deposits up to 100,000 euros, separately for identified persons whose funds a depositor holds
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2026. gada 29. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 421 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 123, 01.07.2026.), 11., 12. un 13. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Report each depositor's covered deposits up to 100,000 euros, separately for identified persons whose funds a depositor holds

summaries.en: A deposit taker reports the deposits covered under sections 3 and 4 of the Deposit Guarantee Law at no more than 100,000 euros, disregarding the limits on payouts, and where a depositor holds funds due to another person it has identified, it counts that person's covered deposits separately rather than adding them to the depositor's. It calculates the quarter's average covered deposits as the average of the month-end balances.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File a corrected covered deposits report at once when the auditor's figures differ from those reported
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2026. gada 29. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 421 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 123, 01.07.2026.), 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File a corrected covered deposits report at once when the auditor's figures differ from those reported

summaries.en: Where the audited data from the sworn auditor's check under the Deposit Guarantee Law differ from the unaudited data in a covered deposits report already filed, the deposit taker prepares and files with Latvijas Banka at once a corrected report based on the audited data.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the invoiced quarterly contribution to the deposit guarantee fund within 10 working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2026. gada 29. jūnija noteikumi Nr. 421 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 123, 01.07.2026.), 6. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Pay the invoiced quarterly contribution to the deposit guarantee fund within 10 working days

summaries.en: A deposit taker pays the contribution to the deposit guarantee fund that Latvijas Banka calculates and invoices for each quarter within 10 working days of receiving the invoice, into Latvijas Banka's settlement account named in the regulation.

instruments.title: Add NILLTPF novēršanas iekšējās kontroles sistēmas neatkarīga ārējā audita veikšanas noteikumi, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 365 of 9 December 2024 on how often and how a financial market participant has its anti-money-laundering internal control system audited externally
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 365 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 47(2)(2) of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (preamble); entry into force: point 20 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2025. gada 1. janvārī) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 01.01.2025.)

titles.lv: Noziedzīgi iegūtu līdzekļu legalizācijas un terorisma un proliferācijas finansēšanas novēršanas iekšējās kontroles sistēmas neatkarīga ārējā audita veikšanas noteikumi
titles.en: Regulations on the independent external audit of the internal control system for the prevention of money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing

payload.shortName: NILLTPF novēršanas iekšējās kontroles sistēmas neatkarīga ārējā audita veikšanas noteikumi
payload.officialRef: Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 365 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the anti-money-laundering internal control system and its IT audited externally every two to five years by risk level
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 365 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 2., 3. un 11. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Have the anti-money-laundering internal control system and its IT audited externally every two to five years by risk level

summaries.en: A financial market participant has its internal control system for preventing money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing, its IT systems included, audited independently by an external auditor regularly: at least every five years if its risk is low, every four years if medium-low, every three years if medium-high and every two years if high. The period runs from the last day the final audit report was delivered to it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Choose an external auditor with five years' experience in auditing money laundering risk management and no conflict of interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 365 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 4., 5. un 6. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Choose an external auditor with five years' experience in auditing money laundering risk management and no conflict of interest

summaries.en: A financial market participant ensures that the external auditor has at least five years of professional experience and competence in auditing the management of money laundering and terrorism and proliferation financing risk, IT systems included; a low-risk participant may use a less experienced auditor if Latvijas Banka agrees. The auditor must not be a person related to it, must not be paid on terms that depend on the result and must not have helped improve its internal control system in the last three years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make the external audit cover at least the elements the regulation lists and end in a report with findings and recommendations
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 365 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 7., 8., 9., 10. un 14. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Make the external audit cover at least the elements the regulation lists and end in a report with findings and recommendations

summaries.en: A financial market participant ensures the audit assesses the compliance and effectiveness of its internal control system, going deeper into the controls over its main risks, and covers at least its risk assessment, policies and procedures, risk strategy and limits, customer risk scoring, due diligence, transaction monitoring and reporting, reliance on third parties, record keeping, specialised IT, staff duties and training, a practical test of customer files proportionate to each risk group, the results of internal audit and compliance checks and the remedying of earlier findings. It ensures the report sets out the methodology, the assessment, the findings with their impact and the measures or recommendations for each element; where several auditors share the work, together they cover it in full.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Agree the planned auditor and scope with Latvijas Banka before the audit and file the final report within five working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 365 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 16. un 17. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Agree the planned auditor and scope with Latvijas Banka before the audit and file the final report within five working days

summaries.en: A financial market participant informs Latvijas Banka of each planned independent external audit, naming the auditor and the scope, and starts the audit only after Latvijas Banka has agreed. It files the final audit report with Latvijas Banka within five working days of receiving it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt a remediation plan within three months of the audit report, agree it with Latvijas Banka and report on it every quarter
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 365 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 18. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Adopt a remediation plan within three months of the audit report, agree it with Latvijas Banka and report on it every quarter

summaries.en: Within three months of receiving the final audit report a financial market participant draws up a plan to remedy the shortcomings found and carry out the recommendations, approved by its management board or highest governing body. It agrees the plan with Latvijas Banka within a month of that approval and informs Latvijas Banka in writing at least once a quarter of its progress.

instruments.title: Add Noteikumi par informācijas sniegšanu Latvijas Bankai par kredītiestādes klientiem un to darījumiem, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 301 of 27 May 2024 on the client and transaction data a credit institution compiles and files when Latvijas Banka asks
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 27. maija noteikumi Nr. 301 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 103, 29.05.2024.), consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2025; issued under section 37.¹ of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (preamble); entry into force: point 11 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2024. gada 2. augustā) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 02.08.2024.)

titles.lv: Noteikumi par kārtību, kādā kredītiestāde sniedz Latvijas Bankai informāciju par klientiem un klientu veiktajiem darījumiem, sniedzamās informācijas apjomu un apkopošanas prasībām
titles.en: Regulations on how a credit institution provides Latvijas Banka with information on its clients and their transactions, and on the scope of the information and the requirements for compiling it

payload.shortName: Noteikumi par informācijas sniegšanu Latvijas Bankai par kredītiestādes klientiem un to darījumiem
payload.officialRef: Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 27. maija noteikumi Nr. 301 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 103, 29.05.2024.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Compile and file the client and transaction data Latvijas Banka requests within 15 calendar days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 27. maija noteikumi Nr. 301 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 103, 29.05.2024.), 2., 3., 5. un 6. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2025

titles.en: Compile and file the client and transaction data Latvijas Banka requests within 15 calendar days

summaries.en: At Latvijas Banka's request a credit institution compiles and files, within 15 calendar days or another period Latvijas Banka sets, information on the clients it had a business relationship with in the period named and on their transactions. Within the scope requested this covers natural and legal person clients, their beneficial owners and representatives, non-cash, card and cash transactions, monthly account and cash turnover, loro correspondent account turnover and card users, filed electronically through Latvijas Banka's secure system.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the filed client data accurate and resubmit the whole file when an error is found
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 27. maija noteikumi Nr. 301 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 103, 29.05.2024.), 4., 7. un 8. punkts, consolidated text, the version in force from 01.07.2025

titles.en: Keep the filed client data accurate and resubmit the whole file when an error is found

summaries.en: A credit institution gives the information as it stands on the last day of the reporting period and ensures it is accurate and matches the current data in its information systems. When Latvijas Banka points out errors it resubmits the requested information in full within three working days unless told otherwise, and when it finds errors itself it reports them to Latvijas Banka at once and resubmits the whole file.

instruments.title: Add Korespondentattiecību un klientu maksājumu pārskata sagatavošanas un iesniegšanas noteikumi, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 383 of 16 December 2024 on the report a credit institution files on its clients', respondents' and nostro correspondents' payment flows
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 383 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 249, 20.12.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 37.¹ of the Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (preamble); entry into force: point 13 (Noteikumi stājas spēkā 2025. gada 1. janvārī) and the passport (Stājas spēkā: 01.01.2025.)

titles.lv: Kredītiestāžu korespondentattiecību ietvaros veikto un saņemto maksājumu un kredītiestāžu klientu veikto un saņemto maksājumu pārskata sagatavošanas un iesniegšanas noteikumi
titles.en: Regulations on preparing and filing the report on payments made and received within credit institutions' correspondent relationships and by credit institutions' clients

payload.shortName: Korespondentattiecību un klientu maksājumu pārskata sagatavošanas un iesniegšanas noteikumi
payload.officialRef: Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 383 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 249, 20.12.2024.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the report on clients', respondents' and nostro correspondents' payment flows within 20 days of the period's end
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 383 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 249, 20.12.2024.), 5., 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: File the report on clients', respondents' and nostro correspondents' payment flows within 20 days of the period's end

summaries.en: A credit institution prepares a report on the incoming and outgoing payments of its clients, of its respondents' clients and of third banks' clients on the forms M 01.00, M 02.00 and M 03.00, as at the last day of the reporting period, and files it with Latvijas Banka through the secure system no later than 20 days after the period ends. It sends Latvijas Banka the contact details of the person who prepares the report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give each payment flow's institutions, countries, codes, currency, direction, number and amount, and nostro balances
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 16. decembra noteikumi Nr. 383 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 249, 20.12.2024.), 3., 4., 6. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Give each payment flow's institutions, countries, codes, currency, direction, number and amount, and nostro balances

summaries.en: A credit institution gives in the report the name, country and BIC of the originating and receiving institutions, the currency, the direction of the flow, the client's country, the number and euro amount of payments, the name, type, country and BIC of each respondent, and each nostro correspondent's available and encumbered balance and incoming and outgoing turnover, marking with a minus sign what is not available. It reports at individual level without the clients of its branches abroad, and leaves out transactions in financial instruments and the cash pooling between group members registered and active in Latvia, Lithuania or Estonia.

instruments.title: Add Minimālās prasības ar maksājumu kontu saistīto pakalpojumu cenrādim un pakalpojumu maksas pārskatam, Latvijas Banka's regulation No 315 of 17 September 2024 on the fee information document and statement of fees for payment accounts and the standard terms they use
instruments.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 315 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions; issued under section 60.¹(1) and (2) and section 60.²(2) of the Law on Payment Services and Electronic Money (preamble); entry into force: the passport (Stājas spēkā: 20.09.2024.), the text having no such point

titles.lv: Minimālās prasības ar maksājumu kontu saistīto pakalpojumu cenrādim un pakalpojumu maksas pārskatam
titles.en: Minimum requirements for the fee information document and the statement of fees for services linked to a payment account

payload.shortName: Minimālās prasības ar maksājumu kontu saistīto pakalpojumu cenrādim un pakalpojumu maksas pārskatam
payload.officialRef: Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 315 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Name payment account services by the standardised terms of the annex in the fee information document and statement of fees
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 315 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 2. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Name payment account services by the standardised terms of the annex in the fee information document and statement of fees

summaries.en: When a payment service provider prepares its fee information document and its statement of fees, it uses for each service listed in the annex the standardised term the annex gives for it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare the fee information document and statement of fees in the EU form, legibly, in the account currency and in Latvian
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 315 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 3., 4., 5., 6. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Prepare the fee information document and statement of fees in the EU form, legibly, in the account currency and in Latvian

summaries.en: A payment service provider prepares the fee information document in the form and with the content of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/34 and the statement of fees for a consumer in the form, content and manner of delivery of Regulation (EU) 2018/33. It keeps both concise, understandable and easy to read in colour and in black-and-white print or copy, in the currency of the payment account and in Latvian, unless the consumer has agreed another currency or language.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show the payment account's total annual cost indicator in the fee information document and the statement of fees
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 17. septembra noteikumi Nr. 315 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 183, 19.09.2024.), 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Show the payment account's total annual cost indicator in the fee information document and the statement of fees

summaries.en: A payment service provider shows the comprehensive cost indicator, which sums up the payment account's total annual costs, in a separate table at the end of the fee information document and in the summary section of the statement of fees.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As the receiving provider, take the switching request and ask the transferring provider to act within two working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. septembra noteikumi Nr. 312 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 172, 04.09.2024.), 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: As the receiving provider, take the switching request and ask the transferring provider to act within two working days

summaries.en: A receiving payment service provider lets the consumer learn about account switching, including when a switch is not possible, identifies the consumer, accepts the written switching request, opens a payment account if there is none, and within two working days of accepting the request asks the transferring provider to carry out the tasks it names.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As the transferring provider, check for obstacles to the switch and tell the receiving provider within five working days
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. septembra noteikumi Nr. 312 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 172, 04.09.2024.), 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: As the transferring provider, check for obstacles to the switch and tell the receiving provider within five working days

summaries.en: On receiving the request a transferring payment service provider first checks whether anything prevents the tasks, such as a credit agreement or a financial collateral arrangement tied to the account. If so, it tells the receiving provider within five working days that the switch cannot be made and discloses the reasons only to the consumer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As the transferring provider, hand over standing orders and payment history within five working days and move the balance and close the account on the date set
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. septembra noteikumi Nr. 312 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 172, 04.09.2024.), 10. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: As the transferring provider, hand over standing orders and payment history within five working days and move the balance and close the account on the date set

summaries.en: Where nothing prevents the switch, the transferring provider sends the receiving provider within five working days the list of standing orders, the incoming credit transfers of the last 13 months with their frequency and the merchant bills and automatic bill payments. On the date in the request it stops accepting incoming transfers it cannot redirect automatically, cancels the standing orders, transfers any positive balance and closes the account once all obligations are settled, telling the consumer at once if unsettled obligations prevent closure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As the receiving provider, set up the standing orders and inform payers within five working days of receiving the information
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 2. septembra noteikumi Nr. 312 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 172, 04.09.2024.), 11. un 12. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: As the receiving provider, set up the standing orders and inform payers within five working days of receiving the information

summaries.en: Within five working days of receiving the information from the transferring provider, the receiving provider sets up the standing orders the consumer asked for and executes them from the date requested, gives the payers named in the request the details of the new account, asking the consumer for anything it lacks, and, where the consumer has not authorised it to inform payers, sends the consumer standard letters with the account details and start date. It exchanges information with the transferring provider through an encrypted electronic channel.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document a strategy for at least three years and draw up an operating plan each year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. februāra noteikumi Nr. 275 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 44, 01.03.2024.), 8. un 9. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Document a strategy for at least three years and draw up an operating plan each year

summaries.en: A payment or e-money institution develops and documents a strategy for at least three years that sets its business aims, target markets and clients, a risk strategy with its risk appetite and how it keeps to it, its liquidity management aims and its strategy for maintaining capital adequacy. It draws up a plan for each year with at least its planned financial position, market position, aims, activities and the most likely risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a documented organisational structure reviewed every year that divides incompatible duties
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. februāra noteikumi Nr. 275 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 44, 01.03.2024.), 12., 14., 16. un 18. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep a documented organisational structure reviewed every year that divides incompatible duties

summaries.en: A payment or e-money institution sets up a transparent organisational structure suited to its size and risks, reviews it at least once a year and updates it after material changes, and documents the duties, powers and responsibility of its management and staff and its reporting lines. It divides duties so that no one can carry out a transaction alone from approval and execution to valuation, reconciliation, safekeeping and booking, and every transaction is authorised at the level the structure sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage conflicts of interest under a documented policy and let staff report control weaknesses and misconduct internally
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. februāra noteikumi Nr. 275 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 44, 01.03.2024.), 25., 26. un 27. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Manage conflicts of interest under a documented policy and let staff report control weaknesses and misconduct internally

summaries.en: A payment or e-money institution develops and documents a conflicts of interest policy and procedures for its management and all staff that identify actual and potential conflicts in good time and prevent them, and takes organisational and administrative measures so that clients' interests are not harmed. In proportion to its size it lets management and staff report internally actual or potential weaknesses of the internal control system and unlawful or unethical dealings, under documented procedures it makes known to them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run documented risk management policies, with money laundering and sanctions risk built in, and review them every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. februāra noteikumi Nr. 275 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 44, 01.03.2024.), 28., 29., 30., 31. un 32. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Run documented risk management policies, with money laundering and sanctions risk built in, and review them every year

summaries.en: A payment or e-money institution develops, documents and applies policies and procedures to identify, measure, control and report every material risk of its business, using sound quantitative and qualitative criteria, and builds money laundering, terrorism and proliferation financing risk and sanctions risk into its risk management system. At least once a year it reviews and improves those policies against changes in its business and environment and assesses how well they and its remedies for their shortcomings work.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Vet new payment services, new market segments and material changes under a documented policy
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. februāra noteikumi Nr. 275 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 44, 01.03.2024.), 33., 34. un 35. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Vet new payment services, new market segments and material changes under a documented policy

summaries.en: A payment or e-money institution adopts and applies a policy for introducing new payment services, offering existing ones to new market segments or materially changing how they are provided. The policy defines a new service and a material change and requires an assessment of the fit with the risk strategy and the effect on the risk profile, of the readiness of management and staff and of the resources available; an e-money institution applies it to material changes in issuing, distributing and redeeming e-money.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an independent internal audit function that works to an approved plan and reports at least yearly
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 26. februāra noteikumi Nr. 275 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 44, 01.03.2024.), 45., 48., 50., 51. un 52. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Keep an independent internal audit function that works to an approved plan and reports at least yearly

summaries.en: A payment or e-money institution sets up an internal audit unit or equivalent function suited to its size and business, documents its powers, keeps it apart from day-to-day operations and controls, gives it free access to all documents, information and staff and staffs it competently. Internal audit works to a plan approved by the supervisory board, or by the shareholders where there is no board, reports the findings of each audit with recommendations, follows up their implementation and reports on its audits at least once a year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer a binary option to a retail client only if it pays out at least the client's outlay, runs 90 days and carries no market risk for the firm
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 362 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 4. un 5. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Offer a binary option to a retail client only if it pays out at least the client's outlay, runs 90 days and carries no market risk for the firm

summaries.en: A firm may offer a binary option to a retail client only if the lower of the two amounts the contract can pay is at least the total the client paid for it, fees and other costs included, and the contract also runs at least 90 calendar days from issue to expiry, is covered by a prospectus the firm has drawn up and had approved under the Financial Instrument Market Law, and creates no market risk for the firm, which with its group makes no profit or loss on it beyond the stated fees.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Require initial margin of 3.33 to 50 per cent of the notional value before a retail client opens a contract for difference
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 362 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 7. punkts un 6.1. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Require initial margin of 3.33 to 50 per cent of the notional value before a retail client opens a contract for difference

summaries.en: A firm requires a retail client to pay initial margin before gaining access to a contract for difference, from 3.33 per cent of the notional value for pairs of the major currencies the regulation lists, through 5, 10 and 20 per cent for the other classes it sets, to 50 per cent where the underlying is a cryptocurrency. The margin does not include fees, transaction charges and other related costs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Close out a retail client's contracts for difference at half the initial margin and cap losses at the funds in the account
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 362 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 6.2. un 6.3. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Close out a retail client's contracts for difference at half the initial margin and cap losses at the funds in the account

summaries.en: A firm closes one or more of a retail client's open contracts for difference on the terms most favourable to the client when the funds in the client's trading account plus the unrealised net profit of all its open contracts fall below half the initial margin paid for them. It also limits the client's total liability for all contracts for difference linked to the trading account to the funds in that account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give retail clients no payment or other benefit linked to marketing or selling contracts for difference
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 362 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 6.4. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Give retail clients no payment or other benefit linked to marketing or selling contracts for difference

summaries.en: A firm makes no payment and gives no monetary or non-monetary benefit, directly or indirectly, to a retail client in connection with marketing, distributing or selling contracts for difference, other than information and research tools relating to those contracts and the profits realised on them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Put the prescribed risk warning, with the firm's own share of losing accounts updated every three months, in every retail communication on contracts for difference
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2024. gada 9. decembra noteikumi Nr. 362 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 241, 11.12.2024.), 8. punkts un 6.5. apakšpunkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Put the prescribed risk warning, with the firm's own share of losing accounts updated every three months, in every retail communication on contracts for difference

summaries.en: A firm sends or publishes no communication to retail clients on contracts for difference without a prominent risk warning in the format the annex sets for the medium, in the same language and at least the usual font size. The warning states the firm's own percentage of retail trading accounts that lost money, calculated every three months over the preceding 12 months with all costs included, or the annex's standard wording where it opened no such contract in the last 12 months.

titles.en: Regulations supplementing the requirements of the legislation governing the crypto-asset market

obligations.title: Add the duty: Build an asset-referenced token issuer's governance to the EBA guidelines on minimum governance requirements
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2025. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 388 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 78, 23.04.2025.), 4. un 5. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Build an asset-referenced token issuer's governance to the EBA guidelines on minimum governance requirements

summaries.en: An issuer of asset-referenced tokens sets up its governance arrangements in line with the EBA guidelines EBA/GL/2024/06 on the minimum content of the governance arrangements of such issuers. An issuer that is a credit institution follows those guidelines to the extent and in the way the second sentence of their paragraph 11 sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run liquidity stress tests on the common reference parameters of the EBA guidelines
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2025. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 388 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 78, 23.04.2025.), 6. un 7. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Run liquidity stress tests on the common reference parameters of the EBA guidelines

summaries.en: An issuer of a significant asset-referenced token and an e-money institution issuing a significant e-money token follow the EBA guidelines EBA/GL/2024/08 on common reference parameters for liquidity stress test scenarios when they carry out liquidity stress tests. An issuer of a token that is not significant does the same where Latvijas Banka has required it to carry out liquidity stress tests under Article 35(4) or 58(2) of the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up the token recovery and redemption plans to the EBA guidelines and file them with Latvijas Banka electronically
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2025. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 388 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 78, 23.04.2025.), 8., 9., 10., 11., 12. un 13. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Draw up the token recovery and redemption plans to the EBA guidelines and file them with Latvijas Banka electronically

summaries.en: An issuer of asset-referenced tokens or e-money tokens draws up and maintains its recovery plan in line with the EBA guidelines EBA/GL/2024/07, and draws up, reviews and updates its redemption plan and sets its triggers in line with the EBA guidelines EBA/GL/2024/13, an e-money token issuer with no duty to hold a reserve of assets leaving out the parts on the reserve. It files each plan with Latvijas Banka electronically at its official electronic address.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure each member of the management body meets the joint EBA and ESMA suitability criteria
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2025. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 388 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 78, 23.04.2025.), 14. un 15. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Ensure each member of the management body meets the joint EBA and ESMA suitability criteria

summaries.en: An issuer of asset-referenced tokens and a crypto-asset service provider ensure that each member of their management body meets the criteria of the joint EBA and ESMA guidelines EBA/GL/2024/09, ESMA75-453128700-10 on assessing the suitability of members of the management body. This does not apply to a crypto-asset service provider that is a credit institution or an investment firm.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform clients of their rights and duties before and during crypto-asset transfer services under policies built to the ESMA guidelines
obligations.sourceLabel: Likumi.lv, Latvijas Bankas 2025. gada 14. aprīļa noteikumi Nr. 388 (Latvijas Vēstnesis, 78, 23.04.2025.), 18. un 19. punkts, consolidated text, the text as published, which the page shows without later versions

titles.en: Inform clients of their rights and duties before and during crypto-asset transfer services under policies built to the ESMA guidelines

summaries.en: A crypto-asset service provider that transfers crypto-assets on behalf of clients informs each client of its rights and duties before and while it provides the service, as Article 82(1) of the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation requires. For this it develops policies and procedures in line with the ESMA guidelines ESMA35-1872330276-2032 on procedures and policies, including client rights, for crypto-asset transfer services.
